# CANDIDATE: VIX_MORNING_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that entering BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON only when VIX is above 15 and the time is between 09:35 and 11:00 ET improves edge capture by avoiding low-VIX chop and afternoon mean-reversion.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger: BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup fires (level rejection + EMA ribbon flip + confluence). Additional filters: VIX >= 15 (real-time VIX from cached data) and entry time between 09:35 and 11:00 ET. Exit logic remains unchanged (chart stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +50%, runner exit as per playbook).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.
2. **Sample bias:** 16-month SPY 5m data (Jan 2025-Jun 2026); selection method: all bars that pass base BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON trigger; overfit risk: adding two filters may overfit, mitigated by walk-forward OOS.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will conduct walk-forward on held-out window after Stage-1).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will validate on top 3 J days using realistic simulator).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: VIX filter blocks a big winner (e.g., 5/04 if VIX <15); max drawdown: could increase if we miss runners; blow-up scenario: persistent low-VIX regime causing chronic underperformance.
6. **Concentration:** TBD after backtest; if top-5 days >50% of P&L, will disclose.

## Pre-merge gate

Stage-1 backtest must pass edge_capture >= 771, walk-forward OOS Sharpe > 0.7, real-fills validation on top 3 J days within ±20% of BS sim, and concentration check (top5_pct <= 200%).

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- based on prior observation that VIX >15 tends to coincide with better put performance, but untested on this specific trigger.
